title: Check an electron’s quantum numbers
statement:
Which tuple (n, ℓ, mℓ, ms) is valid?

[_]{a}

explanations: Every number lies in its allowed range.
The magnitude of mℓ exceeds ℓ.
Electron spin projection cannot be zero.

hints: Check n and ℓ before mℓ.
solution: Check n and ℓ before mℓ. mℓ must be between −ℓ and +ℓ. Spin is exactly ±1/2. Every number lies in its allowed range.
